admin.note: Initial password is Admin. Change it in /admin → Settings. This gate is client-side only; real write access comes from the GitHub token entered in the admin.

valuation_chat.note: Reserved: set ai_endpoint to a server URL that accepts {messages:[...]} and returns {reply:"..."} to turn the chat into a live AI assistant.

lead_webhook.note: Reserved: POST each completed chat/lead to a CRM or Google Sheet webhook.

mls_idx_feed.note: Reserved: live MLS/IDX feed (needs an IDX vendor agreement through Cindy's MLS).
